passages: While we doubt whether Knight 's requirement of a deposit in the registry of the court is the only way to be successful on such a defense, the facts in this case are clear . The Fernandezes neither offered to pay their unpaid mortgage payment s into the court 's registry nor did they have in their possession the amount due under the mortgage when th is suit was initiated. Accordingly, the defense of tender of payment fails and does not excuse the Fernandezes ' missed mortgage payments.
